games.title: Emoji Hunter
games.shortDescription: Can Bluey survive the long dark cold night? Help them defend against mobs of monsters, zombies and freaky demons of all kinds and stay alive for as long as possible.
games.longDescription: In this sentient universe, Bluey was just another block of stinky tofu waiting to be thrown into a hot pot. Yet on one unfortunate night, he was accidentally thrown out and left to rot in the alley ways and the gritty streets of the downtown food district. Can he survive the dangers that come with leaving his cozy kitchen? Help him stay alive as long as you can.

games.title: Pet Mage
games.shortDescription: Command a powerful wizard and their magical pet companions. Summon fairy allies, unleash spells, and survive endless waves of monsters.
games.longDescription: Pet Mage is a fast-paced auto-battler where your wizard and their magical companions battle for survival. Summon fairy pets, dodge enemy swarms, and outlast the endless horde in this free browser game.

games.title: Batzy Boy
games.shortDescription: Tap to flap a bat through endless skies. Dodge monsters, collect fruit, and level up.
games.longDescription: Batzy Boy is a one-tap casual arcade game where you flap a bat through an endless side-scrolling world, dodging monsters and collecting fruit to score points and level up.
